Check out Amazon Web Services it's perfect to make sandboxes that you just want to play around with. You only pay for what you actually use, so it's extremely cheap (like less than a dollar) if only a couple friends are connecting.

(Fun fact: You got my 100th upvote)

namecheap.com

I recommend namecheap as a host simply because I love their philosophy, huge internet privacy advocates.

I recommend feralhosting or digital ocean for a very cheap VPS service which it sounds like you are looking for.

https://www.digitalocean.com they have servers that start at around less than 15 cents a day. To run voat source code, you might need a 1Gb RAM VPS.

There's really only one criteria: do NOT sign up with an EIG company! A decent starting list is here (http://researchasahobby.com/full-list-eig-hosting-companies-brands/) or here (http://www.webhostingchoose.com/business/all-endurance-international-web-hosting-brands/)

EIG companies are some of the biggest, such as BlueHost and HostGator, and some of the most respected hosts before they got bought out and run into the ground, like ASmallOrange.com. All EIG brands are absolutely notorious for downtime, poor administrators, and cutting literally every corner that can be cut, and once acquired give up all technical individuality to be managed as a collective. You might save a dollar or two with an EIG company, but you'll hate every second of it, and WILL experience downtime.

A couple of non-EIG brands to consider if you want something cPanel-based and semi-managed might be www.stablehost.com or www.crocweb.com. If you're going to build the server yourself I'm a HUUUUUGE fan of Linode.com and have several nodes there running well over 365 continuous days.
